source: Original, modelled on 7-10PreQuiz_Log-functions problem 4; version C quarterly compounding plus continuous equivalent.

parts.label: a
parts.description: Write a formula for 3200 dollars invested at 7.2% per annum, compounded quarterly, in the form V(t)=a(b)^(4t).
parts.notes: M1 for quarterly rate 0.072/4 = 0.018 or growth factor 1.018. A1 for V(t)=3200(1.018)^(4t).

parts.label: b
parts.description: Write the model in equivalent continuous form V(t)=3200e^(kt), giving the exact value of k.
parts.notes: M1 for using (1.018)^(4t)=e^(4t ln(1.018)) or equivalent. A1 for k=4ln(1.018).

parts.label: c
parts.description: Find the smallest number of full years for the account value to first exceed 5000 dollars.
parts.tolerance: Accept n = 7. Do not accept 6.25... years as the final answer because full years are required. Alternative method (table search) acceptable: full marks if both adjacent rows are shown (3200(1.018)^24 = 4910.48 at n=6 and 3200(1.018)^28 = 5273.18 at n=7); award full marks for a single-row table too, but attach a feedback note recommending the adjacent row.
parts.notes: M1 for setting 3200(1.018)^(4n) > 5000 or an equivalent method. A1 for the smallest full-year value n = 7. If the student uses a single-row table, attach feedback: 'Show both adjacent rows (n=6 and n=7) to justify the crossover.' See markscheme-spec.md §18.

source: Original, modelled on 7-10PreQuiz_Log-functions problem 3; version C continuous growth with k unknown.

parts.label: a
parts.description: Find k for U(t)=9000e^(kt), k>0, given U(3)=18500.
parts.tolerance: Accept k = (1/3)ln(18500/9000) or a decimal equivalent.
parts.notes: M1 for substituting U(3)=18500 to get 9000e^(3k)=18500 or equivalent. A1 for k=(1/3)ln(18500/9000)=0.2401...

parts.label: b
parts.description: Find the number of users after 7 years, correct to the nearest whole number.
parts.tolerance: Accept 48352 (full precision) or 48290 (obtained by substituting rounded k = 0.240). Both earn full marks; if 48290 is given, attach feedback about not rounding intermediate values. See markscheme-spec.md §17.
parts.notes: M1 for substituting t=7 using their value of k. A1 for 48352 (full precision) or 48290 (from rounded k=0.240). If the rounded-k variant is used, attach feedback: 'Carry full precision through intermediate steps; round only the final answer.'

parts.label: c
parts.description: Find the time in years when the users first reach 50000, correct to two decimal places.
parts.tolerance: Accept 7.14 (full precision) or 7.15 (obtained by substituting rounded k = 0.240). Both earn full marks; if 7.15 is given, attach feedback about not rounding intermediate values. See markscheme-spec.md §17.
parts.notes: M1 for setting 9000e^(kt)=50000 and solving with logarithms. A1 for 7.14 (full precision) or 7.15 (from rounded k=0.240). If the rounded-k variant is used, attach feedback: 'Carry full precision through intermediate steps; round only the final answer.'
parts.follow_through: Award follow-through from the candidate's value of k in part (a) if the logarithmic method is correct.
